comment: Copy to radio_plan.json and edit. Slots are assigned to HackRFs in uniqueID order: 1st radio gets slot 0, 2nd gets slot 1, and so on. Extra radios beyond the last slot are left untouched. Each slot is one tuner's receive window: center freq_hz +/- sample_rate/2. lna is the HackRF LNA (IF) gain in dB, 0-40 in steps of 8; vga is the baseband gain in dB, 0-62 in steps of 2; amp is the front-end amplifier. Raise gain for weak simulcast, drop amp and lna for a strong nearby site that overloads the front end. overrides keys are HackRF uniqueIDs (as they appear in SDRTrunk's tuner_configuration.json) and win over the slot's gain, so one radio on a different antenna can be tuned independently of the band plan.
